SECTION 1

* The text discusses the challenges faced by young adults, particularly millennials, in affording a home in the UK.
* The author, a 24-year-old, feels frustrated by the older generation's criticism of their spending habits, as the rising cost of property and reduced lending by banks make it increasingly difficult for young people to own their own homes.
* The author suggests that many young people may be forced to rent for the rest of their lives, while property owners continue to complain about their perceived irresponsibility.
* The text also highlights the issue of lower wages for under-25s, who can be paid as little as £7.05 per hour or £5.60 per hour, even when working full-time.
* The text emphasizes that young people are more likely to be on zero-hour contracts, further contributing to the financial challenges they face.
